svg.title: HOMO-LUMO gap versus conjugation length
svg.desc: Energy level diagram for ethene, butadiene, hexatriene and beta-carotene showing the HOMO-LUMO gap shrinking
svg.text: Modern (MO) theory: more conjugation → smaller HOMO–LUMO gap → longer wavelength
π → π* excitation energy ΔE = hc/λ ≈ 1240/λ(nm) eV
Each extra C=C raises the HOMO and lowers the LUMO, so ΔE falls and λmax shifts to longer wavelength (bathochromic shift).
Particle-in-a-box: ΔE = (N+1)h² / 8mL² — a longer conjugated chain (larger L) means a smaller gap.
